title: Maximum Sum of an Hourglass
summary: Given an m x n integer matrix, find the maximum sum of an hourglass, which is a specific 3x3 submatrix pattern.
statement: Given an m x n integer matrix, find the maximum sum of an hourglass, which is a specific 3x3 submatrix pattern.
constraints: An hourglass uses three cells in a top row, the centered cell below, and three cells in the following row.
The grid has at least three rows and columns.
Return the maximum sum over all hourglass placements.
hints: Enumerate each top-left position with room for a three-by-three box.
Add the three top cells, the middle center, and the three bottom cells.
Track the maximum across every placement, initializing below possible negative sums.
Every hourglass has one such top-left coordinate and those seven terms, so enumeration is exact.
